documentsoort.title: Document type
documentsoort.description: The kind of document, from the national list of document types. The national Woo index reads it. Stored as the resource address of the list member.

fileDocumentsoorten.title: Document type per file
fileDocumentsoorten.description: A different document type for one attached file, for example an annex to a decision. Keyed by the file id; each value is a member of the national list of document types.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language the document is written in.

creationDate.title: Creation date
creationDate.description: The day the document was made. This is not the day it was published.

validFrom.title: Valid from
validFrom.description: The day the content takes legal effect. This can differ from the publication date.

validUntil.title: Valid until
validUntil.description: The day the content loses legal effect. Leave it empty when it has no end.
